plan: Built from the crack line. Taunt replaces Parting Shot on Incineroar because Taunt is the single stated answer - it shuts off Heal Pulse, Light Screen and Wish in one action. Everything else is burst rather than chip, because a priority half-heal beats chip damage by construction: Mega Metagross (Ice Punch is 4x into Dragonite, Steel is 2x into Florges), Rillaboom (Grass 2x into Milotic), Zapdos (Thunderbolt 2x into Milotic, Heat Wave 2x into Meganium), Urshifu (always-crit burst that ignores Protect), Amoonguss (Sludge Bomb 2x into Florges). Known trap to respect: Milotic's Competitive turns Incineroar's Intimidate and any Icy Wind into +2 Special Attack, so Intimidate must not be spent while Milotic is on the field. Known non-answer: Spore cannot touch Meganium, which is Grass, and Florges' Flower Veil protects it from status anyway.
